guide: Open Start and type your business name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the days for a thank-you, the stars you want, the fill you want, the cost of an instructor hour and the cost per signed client you accept.
Check Sources, Class Types and Team. They hold the gift value of each source, the usual price and seats of each class and the phones the message links read.
Write every referral in Referrals: date, source, referrer, enquiry, client and the thank-you date. The client, income and thank-you check fill in by themselves.
Keep Enquiries, Clients and Contracts up to date: the source of each client decides what every source earned.
Write each class in Class Sessions and each sign-up in Class Attendees. Profit, break-even and fill fill in; Class Economics and Class by Type compare sessions.
Write each review request in Reviews with the date asked, the date received, the stars and the channel. No review text is kept.
Write the marketing spend of each month in Marketing Spend with its enquiries and signed clients. Source Costs and the Marketing Keep or Drop tool read it.
Read Referral Value by Source, Referrer Ranking, Thank-you Due and the Referral Gap List every month to see who to thank and who to visit.
Use the 18 tools to rank sources, price classes, plan the class calendar, run the review pipeline, keep or drop marketing and watch the source mix.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Referrals Dashboard and the charts every month. A solo doula uses the same sheets with one doula and fewer sources.

listing.title: Doula Business Referrals, Classes, Reviews and Marketing Excel Template: Referral Source Value, Class Break-even, Review Tracker
listing.headline: See which sources, classes and reviews really grow your doula business
listing.description:
Find out where your doula clients really come from and what keeps them coming, in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-doula who also takes clients, contracted doulas and a part-time admin, and just as useful for a solo doula with fewer sources. Referrals records every enquiry sent to you, the referrer, the client it became and the date you said thank you. Referral Value by Source ranks the sources by income and not by count, Source Costs shows the cost of gifts and fees, and Referrer Ranking shows who sent the most and who went quiet.

Class Sessions and Class Attendees record each class and workshop with seats, sign-ups, venue cost and income. Class Economics, Class by Type and the break-even tools show profit per class hour and the sign-ups you need. Reviews records every review request with stars and channel but no text, and Review Requests Due lists the clients to ask or remind. Marketing Spend ties each listing, post or flyer to enquiries and signed clients.

18 tools answer the weekly questions: which sources to feed, hold or cut, who to thank, who to visit, what a class earns, how many sign-ups cover a session, whether a price should rise, what the next 3 months of classes will bring, who to ask for a review, which marketing to keep or drop and whether one source carries too much. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to referrers, past clients, enquirers, class attendees, the class venue and the owner-doula.

This is part seven of the Doula Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Clients appear by name and dates only, with no medical detail. It helps you keep track of dates, hours, money and capacity and does not promise any result. Check your local rules for records, consent and tax.

documents.title: Thank-you letter to a care-provider office
paragraphs: Thank-you letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:referrers.referrer},
Thank you for the people you sent to us. In the last 12 months you referred {col:referrers.last12} people, and {col:referrers.clients} clients have come to us through you in all.

We keep our work simple: dates, hours and clear prices, with each client's care staying with their own care provider. We would be glad to visit you, share our information sheet and hear how we can make referring easier.
With thanks, and we hope to stay in touch.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business and check your local rules.

With warm thanks.
